title: Stockroom
short_description: Manage electronic parts, sourcing evidence, CAD assets, and EDA libraries.
description: Stockroom keeps electronic component data, supplier evidence, CAD assets, and library workflows together. Add a part by exact manufacturer part number, review information from configured official sources, obtain CAD files through provider pages when needed, and stage verified assets into your local catalog. Stockroom supports deliberate KiCad and Altium workflows without claiming universal CAD availability or automating provider sign-in.
features: Mouser and DigiKey enrichment when configured
Manual provider browser for CAD acquisition
Local Design Studio drafts and applied designs
testing_instructions: Create or select a library. Add a component using an exact manufacturer part number. Open CAD Models, then Manage Models. Choose a provider and use its page manually when CAD files are required.
